theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (Λ : (Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl n)) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), ContinuousOn Λ {A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P | Function.Injective A} → (∀ A : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl P, Function.Injective A → (Λ A).comp A = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Eucl n) ∧ ∀ v : Eucl P, ‖A (Λ A v)‖ ≤ ‖v‖) → IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∃ G : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q), Measurable G ∧ MeasurableSet (Φ '' Ω) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Φ '' Ω, ∃ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = x ∧ (∀ s : Eucl n, G x (fderiv ℝ Φ w s) = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w s) ∧ ∀ v : Eucl P, ∃ s : Eucl n, ‖fderiv ℝ Φ w s‖ ≤ ‖v‖ ∧ G x v = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w s
